title: India at the 2026 Asian Games
headline: India at the 2026 Asian Games
dek: India sent 495 athletes and English Wikipedia has a huge Indian readership, so this page tracks the medal table closely.
whatItIs: The page that tracks India's athletes and results at the 2026 Asian Games in Japan.
whyNow: India sent 495 athletes and English Wikipedia has a huge Indian readership, so this page tracks the medal table closely. It got an extra push when Vithya Ramraj broke P. T. Usha's national record in the 400 m hurdles, a mark that had stood since the 1984 Olympics. Her own page entered the top 100 the same day.
